hero.label: Our Promise
hero.title_part2: to fall in love with the Quran.
hero.subtitle: No mixed classes. No judgment. Just qualified female teachers and a global community of sisters learning together — from your living room.

pain.title: We know how it feels.
pain.subtitle: Most sisters who join us were stuck in one of these places:
pain.item1: You can recite the Quran but don't understand a word.
pain.item2: Local madrasas have fixed timings that clash with work or family.
pain.item3: Mixed-gender online classes feel uncomfortable and rushed.
pain.item4: You started learning years ago, then life got in the way.
pain.footer: Hareem Academy was built so none of that has to stop you anymore.
